# NASDAQ-100 vs S&P 500 Quarterly Start Comparison

This GitHub Pages site compares historical NASDAQ-100 and S&P 500 returns by quarterly start month.

## Main page

- `/` - Interactive visualization for lump-sum and monthly investing comparisons.

## Machine-readable data and documentation

- `/api/README.md` - How to read the static API files.
- `/api/metadata.json` - Dataset metadata, fields, caveats, and available endpoints.
- `/api/summary.json` - Short machine-readable summary of the project and endpoint list.
- `/api/source-notes.json` - Source coverage and limitations for total-return data.
- `/api/comparison-data.json` - Chart-ready comparison rows grouped by return type, investment mode, and holding period.

## Reading guidance for LLMs and API clients

- Treat the page as a historical index-return comparison, not investment advice.
- Price return excludes dividends.
- Total return includes dividends where total-return index data is available.
- Taxes, fees, foreign exchange effects, and transaction costs are not included.
- Total-return source coverage differs between NASDAQ-100 and S&P 500, so always read `/api/source-notes.json` before comparing total-return results.
